overview: Search engines can only list what they can reach and understand. We crawl your store, read Search Console, and repair the problems that block or confuse them: pages that error, redirect chains, duplicate addresses, wrong canonical tags, a messy sitemap and a faulty robots file. We make the fixes in your own store where the platform allows, and send a before and after list so you can see what changed.

faq: Can every problem be fixed on my platform?
Not always. Hosted platforms limit access to some files. We fix what your platform allows and explain clearly what cannot be changed, with the nearest workaround.
Will fixes change how my store looks?
No. These are behind-the-scenes changes to addresses, tags and settings. If a fix could touch the design, we show you first.
Is there a risk to my current traffic?
We take care with redirects and remove nothing blindly. We save a list of your top pages first and check them after each batch of changes.
Do you need Search Console access?
It is strongly recommended. Search Console shows which pages Google could not reach, and it lets us confirm that a problem has gone.
